Company Release - 10/26/2026 CACI Secures U.S. Navy Task Order to Strengthen Electromagnetic Spectrum Dominance


RESTON, Va.


, Oct. 26, 2026


/[PRNewswire](http://www.prnewswire.com/) / -- CACI International Inc (NYSE: CACI) announced today that it has been awarded a five-year task order valued at up to $281 million by the U.S. Navy's Naval Surface Warfare Center (NSWC) Crane to support in strengthening and advancing next-generation electromagnetic warfare capabilities across the Department of War (DoW).


"Electromagnetic superiority is central to how our nation deters conflict and protects its forces, and this work directly strengthens that advantage in the real world," said[John Mengucci](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4805536-1&h=296098218&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.caci.com%2Fbio%2Fjohn-s-mengucci&a=John+Mengucci) , CACI President and Chief Executive Officer. "By accelerating next‑generation spectrum technologies and AI‑enabled decision tools, we are helping operators stay ahead of increasingly complex global threats. CACI is committed to delivering mission‑ready solutions that safeguard national security and empower our customers at the speed of relevance."


As part of this work, CACI will deliver research, analysis, assessment, and prototype development to enhance electromagnetic spectrum operations (EMSO) across multiple operational environments. The program includes designing and maturing advanced technologies, performing test and evaluation (T&E), and developing infrastructure and capability enhancements to meet emerging operational needs at multiple sites based on unique customer requirements.


**About CACI** CACI International Inc (NYSE: CACI) is a technology-first national security company that expands the limits of national security through innovation, discipline, and operational excellence. We deliver advanced technologies that help our customers move faster, operate more efficiently, and anticipate and defeat evolving threats. Our 27,000 talented employees and strong culture drive our success and have earned CACI recognition as a Fortune World's Most Admired Company. CACI is a member of the Fortune 500™, the Russell 1000 Index, and the S&P MidCap 400 Index. For more information, visit caci.com.
